answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they often produce incorrect outputs... To address this limitation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach... we propose Reliability-Aware RAG (RA-RAG), a new multi-source RAG framework

answer_2.quote: Following prior works, we use accuracy as an evaluation metric, based on whether gold answers are included in model-generated responses.
